svg.aria-label: Mechanism of Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene
svg.title: Mechanism of Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene

g.text: Step 1: the Lewis acid AlCl₃ removes Cl− from the acid chloride → acylium ion (the electrophile)
Step 2: a π bond of benzene attacks the acylium ion (slow) → σ-complex (arenium ion)
Step 3: AlCl₄− removes H+ from the sp³ carbon, aromaticity is restored and AlCl₃ is regenerated
